methods.label: Perpendicular vectors
methods.explanation: The coordinate basis vectors are perpendicular to each other, so their dot product is 0.

methods.label: Coordinate dot product
methods.explanation: Multiplying corresponding coordinates and adding gives \((1,0)\cdot(0,1)=1\times0+0\times1=0\).
methods.levelReason: The coordinate formula is in the same required plane-vector scope and needs no angle calculation.
